video: videos/quickstart.mp4

{{< video videos/quickstart.mp4 >}}

The first film: ubiquitin (1UBQ) turns under the camera, the camera moves in on the
     painted helix (residues 23 to 34), turns a little more, pulls back out, and the
     representation cuts to ball-and-stick.

     ProteinMotion opens with a fade-in and marks the helix with a box highlight. Neither is
     possible yet: a fade needs the `Set Opacity` node and the box needs a `Style Highlight`
     node, so the helix is painted gold in the `Color` attribute instead.

After ProteinMotion's [`quickstart.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/quickstart.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/quickstart.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/quickstart.py"}
{{< include scripts/quickstart.py >}}
```
